'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Mitch Nieland LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
